options: 海陽の計算が導き出した最適解
佐伯がかつて到達した伝説の感覚
灯台の老人が密かに送る合図だった

en.title: Tides of the Surf, Twin Wakes
en.premise: A coastal rowing club on the brink of collapse. A twin brother hailed as the ace, and his sister, the manager, who weaves meticulous strategies from the shadows. A former athlete haunted by failure, a reserve player in charge of records, and an old man watching over them from an ancient lighthouse on the hill—together, they channel their fragmented hopes into a single boat. Between the raging seas and the precise diagrams on the strategy board, they are driven toward a race of absolute limits.

zh.title: 潮骚之艇，双子航迹
zh.premise: 一个濒临废部的沿海划船部。被寄予厚望的王牌双胞胎哥哥，以及在阴影中制定缜密战术的经理妹妹。遭遇挫折的前选手、负责记录的替补选手，以及在山丘上的古老灯塔中注视着他们的老人，将各自零散的思绪汇聚在同一艘艇上。狂暴的大海与战术板上精密的战术图，将他们引导向一场极限的比赛。
